frozen_candidates.C1: all anchor-compatible marked actions on two copies of the 12-dimensional F2 support-two module, modulo Aut_G3 = GL2(2)^3
frozen_candidates.C2: all anchor-compatible marked actions on two copies of the 7-dimensional F3 heart module, modulo GL2(3); the old 21-dimensional component is a direct summand with frozen zero rank
frozen_candidates.C3: all 25 ordered length-two extensions among the five frozen simple F2 G3 modules (dimensions 1,2,6,12,8), restricted to marked classes whose pure restriction is nonsplit

row_universe.formal_class_outcome_universe_if_rank_po: all SURJ classes in lexicographic representative order times all 324 rows

rank_gate.positive_rule: if any row is positive, freeze and run all SURJ class outcomes for that entry
rank_gate.zero_rule: if every row is zero, stop that entry before opening class outcomes

positive_control.source: the frozen ESCAPE-2 result with Im_R_K_M distribution 972:7, plus the ESCAPE-28 evaluated-row count 1099008
positive_control.failure_rule: stop campaign before interpreting any new entry

stop_rule.immediate: first positive obstruction rank in preflight; in a later outcome run, first nonzero obstruction, image below 324, or zero-survival element
stop_rule.mismatch: producer/checker universe, rank distribution, or row digest mismatch

blindness_record.engineering_preflight_scope: basis conventions, finite orbit scale, and rank feasibility only; it is not counted as a formal class/element outcome universe
